title: DWG CP8/ENC/UTF-16 string length boundary fast slice
scope: Characterize CP8 and ENC length-prefixed string writers at the maximum accepted payload and first rejected payload
Characterize UTF-16 length using code units, including an astral scalar and following-byte sentinel
Reuse the existing writer-primitives target and CTest registration

details: CP8 and ENC accept 65,534 payload bytes plus terminator (BS count 65,535), preserve exact bytes, and leave a following sentinel aligned.
TU accepts 65,534 UTF-16 payload code units plus terminator, including one astral surrogate pair; tests exact bytes and following sentinel.
CP8/ENC payloads of 65,535 bytes and TU payloads of 65,535 UTF-16 units fail before writing a length or payload byte.

limitations: This is local writer-wire characterization, not typed SummaryInfo implementation, external producer acceptance, or native CAD qualification. The shared worktree is broadly modified, so the slice remains uncommitted rather than staging unrelated work.
